vacancy.title: Medior/senior R&D Engineer Human Machine Teaming
vacancy.assessment: Secondary NLR opportunity involving autonomous systems, human-machine teaming, demonstrators and technical research/project leadership. MSc mechanical/mechatronics and multidisciplinary project experience are adjacent strengths; the mandatory 8 years relevant HMI/AI experience, including 3 years AI/HIS, plus strong Python/ML or UI/UX expertise are substantial gaps. Amsterdam location offers no direct ESTEC/ESA exposure; salary not stated. Senior stretch rather than a core mechanical-design role.
